name: mirage
text:
Result of the split (575,842 bids since Oct 16, quality = fair after the fill vs the price paid, a closing-line-style measure):
- Over fills: +2.5 pts (226 fills). Under fills: +2.3 pts (362 fills). Same quality. Unders fill about 1.6x as often.
- Underdogs (non-total): +2.8 pts (143 fills). Favorites: +1.9 pts (78 fills). Dogs fill about 2x as often and are about 0.9 pt better, a small but real gap.
- On totals and team totals there is no Over/Under difference.
- Prop Overs did not look worse on this measure. They lost on actual results in the Oct 17 study, so results are what we need to check.

So the data does not show Unders being better quality, and underdogs are only slightly better. Not enough to change the rules. Fills are thin everywhere (0.0-0.4% of bids fill), so league cuts are only 40 or fewer fills each.

Next step: once we have 200 or more settled bid fills per side, I'll check results by side. Notes are in research/bid_side_split_2026-10-23.md.
